entries.en: Give me the evidence.
A friend.
Someone who saved your life.
I'm with the Alliance.
That's him.
That's her.
You sure?
Positive. Move in.
Those were Saren's men.
I guess we're on the right track.
They told me it was you, but I didn't believe it. Shepard grew up and turned into a soldier.
Name's Finch. You probably don't remember me, but we ran together in the Tenth Street Reds.
Maybe you don't remember it yourself, running in a gang. None of the vids mention it when they're talking about you.
Really? What if someone gave an interview talking about Commander Shepard's history in the gangs?
We're not trying to cause you trouble, Shepard. We just want a favor, for old times' sake.
One of the Reds, Curt Weisman, got picked up by turians. We'd like you to talk to the turian guard in the bar and get Curt out.
Since your days, the Reds have expanded.
We do some salvage, a little shipping here and there, that kind of thing.
Some stupid minor offense. Maybe he had a little red sand. You know how the turians are.
They declared him a problem, and they're shipping him back for a trial.
Of course not. But word has it you've got some pull with the aliens.
All we're asking you to do is pull a little for us.
Thanks, Shepard. I knew you'd remember your old friends. The guard's over in Chora's Den.
Suit yourself, Shepard. If you change your mind, he's over in Chora's Den. Take care of this, and you'll never see me again.
And Shepard... you might not run with the Reds anymore, but you really don't want us as your enemies.
An impatient soldier. Who are you, and why are you in my way?
My history's a matter of public record. I've got nothing to hide.
So I ran with the Reds. That's behind me now.
The vids never tell the whole story. So what can I do for the Reds?
What was one of the Tenth Street Reds doing in turian space?
What was this guy arrested for?
You're not asking me to break Weisman out of jail, are you?
I'll talk to the turian and see what I can do.
My gang days are over, Finch. Get out of my way.
I'm sorry. You are?
I'm not ashamed.
That life is over.
Forget the vids.
In Turian Space
Reason for Arrest
Not Jailbreak
Take care of this, and you'll never see me again.
Not now. I'm watching the show.
Hey, you gonna be dancing later?
She's got the nicest smile.
Nothing like a dance to help me unwind at the end of the day.
Hey! I was here first, pal. Get your own spot.
I got business here, but not with you.
Human military, huh?
Why don't you go watch the dancers?
The back rooms are private. Reserved for Fist and his friends.
Personal matter.
Not real chatty, is he?
He owns this club. But the customers have to stay out front.
Enjoy the club.
What did that other krogan want? Wrex?
Who's Fist?
Other krogan
I'm going.
Alliance military. Hmph. I coulda been a marine you know. Instead I joined the goddamned Citadel Security. Biggest mistake of my life.
Garrus? Ha! You must be one of Captain Anderson's crew. Poor bastard's still trying to bring Saren down, eh?
I know where Garrus is. But you gotta tell me something first. Did the captain let you in on his big secret?
But it's all related. Don't you see?
The captain used to be a Spectre. Didn't know that, did you? It was all very hush-hush. The first human ever given that honor. And then he blew it.
Screwed up his mission so bad they kicked him out. Of course, he blames Saren. Says the turian set him up.
Garrus was sniffing around Dr. Michel's office. She runs the med clinic on the other side of the wards. Last I heard, he was going back there.
Yeah. Good. Go. Let me drink in peace.
Harkin, right? I was told you could help me find someone. A turian C-Sec officer named Garrus.
Is there something I should know about the captain?
I just need to know where Garrus is.
Why'd they kick him out?
I'm out of here.
What secret?
Not my concern.
You need something, honey?
Hey there, sweetheart. You looking for some fun? 'Cause I gotta say that soldier getup looks real good on that bod of yours.
Why don't you sit your sweet little ass down beside old Harkin? Have a drink and we'll see where this goes.
Suit yourself, princess. You know, if more marines looked like you, I might've joined the Alliance instead of C-Sec.
Yeah? What do you want?
I'd rather drink a cup of acid after chewing on a razor blade.
You're disgusting.
Go away. [hic] Let me... let me drink in peace.
Relax. That's the problem with you Alliance types: no sense of humor.
You trying to hurt my feelings? You gotta do better than that. After twenty years with C-Sec, I've been called every name in the book, princess.
Fine. Ask Anderson. I bet he tells you. He's too stupid and proud to lie right to your face.
Have to ask him. I never heard any of the details. Bet it's a good story, though. The hero's fall. Classic tragedy. Ha!
I spent twenty years working cases here on the Citadel. People on this station love to talk. Secrets are like herpes. If you got 'em you might as well spread 'em around.
The name's Commander Shepard. Remember that unless you want to start picking your teeth up off the floor.
How well do you know Captain Anderson?
What do you know about Garrus?
What's it like working for C-Sec?
I'm looking for a C-Sec officer. A turian named Garrus.
Why should I believe a drunk like you?
You said they covered all this up. How did you hear about it?
Just tell me where Garrus went.
Don't call me that.
Where's Garrus?
You're lying.
Met him a few times over the years. One of those hard-core military guys. Yes, sir! No, sir! Can't have any fun with a stick up your ass, sir!
That's probably why he climbed the Alliance ranks so fast. The military loves brown-nosers.
Save your sermons. This ain't no church.
Sure. Whatever. Dress him up in a fancy suit, pin some shiny medals on his chest, and call him a hero. Everybody else does.
But if he's so great why'd the Spectres kick him out? Go ask him about that, sweetheart.
But if he's so great, why'd the Spectres kick him out? Why don't you go ask him about that?
You mean what was it like. The executor suspended me without pay -- recurring violations. C-Sec was keeping a file on me. Can you believe that?
Every mistake I ever made went into the books. Get a little rough with a suspect, note in the file. Have a couple drinks on duty, note in the file.
Skim a couple credits off a drug-bust, note in the file. It's a goddamned witch hunt.
What the hell do you know? Working for C-Sec isn't like being a marine. People get pissed off if we shoot somebody. Investigations, inquiries, rules, regulations.
Every day I plow through enough red tape to choke a rhino. That's how you gotta be to do this job. So don't talk to me about right and wrong. You soldiers got it easy.
He'll pay for it soon enough. The executor loves to put us lowly field agents in our place. Just look at what happened to me.
You need to look in a mirror. Sober up and take some responsibility for yourself!
The captain's a good soldier.
You got off easy, if you ask me.
Quit blaming others.
He earned his rank.
Just noticed that now, did you?
Okay. Settle down. He went to speak to Dr. Michel. Over in the med clinic on the other side of the wards.
Damn hothead is what he is. Still figures he can save the world. Always bucking heads with the executor.
You're a pig.
One more chance. Tell me where Garrus is. Now.
Just tell me where Garrus is before this gets ugly.
Maybe you can help me.
Disgusting!
Quit wasting my time.
Okay, okay. Just relax. Garrus, you say? Heh. You must be one of Anderson's crew. Poor bastard's still trying to bring Saren down, eh?
Call me princess again and you'll be picking your teeth up off the floor. Now tell me where Garrus is!
Why didn't Captain Anderson tell us he used to be a Spectre?
Maybe it's not true. Harkin's an ass. I bet he's just messing with our heads.
You're probably right. Still, I'd like to hear what the captain has to say about all this.
Go away. I'm not interested in talking.
Yeah, off you go. See you later, kid.
She left me, just like that.
Who needs her anyway?
Damn asari and their secrets and lies.
Commander? Hmph. What do you want?
Good. Her lies have been killing me for days.
It's a good thing you're an officer or I'd sit you down... and hard.
I've seen a lot of horrible things in my days and there's only one woman in this damn galaxy that helps me forget it.
So if you feel that way, then why spread lies about her?
'Cause she rejected me. Me! Septimus Oraka, general of the turian fleet!
The troops can kiss my leathery backside.  All I wanted was to retire and be with her.
Look, kid, I appreciate what you're trying to do, but don't waste your time.
Ha, war! That's what this feels like all right. How did I let it come to this?
Enemies? The one place I always felt at peace was with her, but now....
I spent all my life acting like a general and what did it get me?
No, those days are over. I'll just be what I am: a tired, lonely, worn-out soldier.
So you think it's that easy? Just straighten up and act like a general?
It sure as hell couldn't hurt.
Huh. Maybe you're right, Commander. Sha'ira's worth the effort... even if she won't have me back.
Say, you're a bright kid. Would you be interested in earning a few extra credits?
